scaffold._discoveryPainPoints:
1. [DataSignalFriction] 60% of customer service time spent on 'where is my order' inquiries due to poor tracking visibility (intensity 8/10, stage: Inquiry Received)
2. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Returns processing takes 12 days end-to-end with opaque manual process leading to chargebacks (intensity 9/10, stage: Return Requested) ← flagged as binding
3. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] Inventory overselling during promotions due to Shopify-warehouse sync issues causing 3-5% order cancellations (intensity 9/10, stage: Order Placed) ← flagged as binding
4. [DataSignalFriction] No visibility into campaign performance by customer lifetime value, preventing marketing optimization (intensity 6/10, stage: Customer Acquired)
5. [ProcessHandoffFriction] New Zealand fulfilment has no defined process with 15% delay rate due to manual customs documentation (intensity 7/10, stage: Order Dispatched)
